  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE]);","note":"The sink is the second free/read of already-released heap storage during cleanup of the decoded ExpandedNodeId object.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"data","via":"dangling storage"}]}]
